title: Genesis DAP-seq sample sheet
description: One row per library. workflows/dap-seq.nf also checks the exact header, reference files, reference IDs and control assignments.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

species.errorMessage: species must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

read1_url.errorMessage: read1_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL

read2_url.errorMessage: read2_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL, or - for single-end libraries

control_sample.errorMessage: control_sample must be a sample_id, or - for a control library

reference_fasta.errorMessage: reference_fasta must be a gzipped FASTA basename ending in .fa.gz, .fasta.gz or .fna.gz
